answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out by the non-revertible security patch. P99 latency is 5x target on the write path during peak settlement traffic. Memory_b2 documents successful regional failover under similar pressure (March degradation), with latency recovery within minutes and clean traffic shifting. Failover lets us shed load without reverting the patch, preserves writes during peak, and has proven execution precedent. Read replica routing (memory_b5) targets dashboard load, not write-path latency. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail fast but don't add capacity. Add capacity takes time we don't have at peak. Failover trades regional complexity for immediate latency relief without losing the security fix or customer writes.
